The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$\land$", while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "$\lor$".

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

- **Part 1:** $4$ is even or $4^2=12.$ This corresponds to
\[
\underbrace{4 \vphantom{p}\textrm{ is even }}_M \quad \underbrace{\vphantom{p}\textbf{or}}_{\lor} \quad \underbrace{4^2=12 }_N,
\]
that is, $M \lor N.$

- **Part 2:** $-2$ is an integer number. This corresponds to $P.$

So, we can express the sentence as
\[

\underbrace{4 \vphantom{p}\textrm{ is even} \textbf{ or } \vphantom{p} 4^2=12}_{M \, \lor \, N}, \quad \underbrace{\vphantom{p}\textbf{and}}_{\land} \quad 
\underbrace{-2 \vphantom{p}\textrm{ is an integer number} }_P 
\]

that is, $(M \lor N) \land P.$
